metaDescription: Revenue & GTM Leader · Curious Builder. Enterprise cybersecurity, relationships, people development, and repeatable systems.
headline: Strategist. Leader. Builder.
lead: Curious by nature. Builder by instinct. I studied advertising and business foundations at The University of Texas at Austin. Advertising taught me to make complex ideas clear and relevant to the audience. Enterprise cybersecurity sales taught me to connect that story to technical evidence and a buying decision.

My career is grounded in hands-on enterprise cybersecurity selling—from complex buyer conversations and technical evaluations to deal execution. I also coach newer sellers and build practical tools and processes that teams can reuse.

principles.name: People first
principles.body: I listen, coach and share context so a teammate can succeed without depending on one person for every answer.

principles.name: Problem-driven
principles.body: I begin with customer or team friction, test assumptions and identify what would actually help before suggesting a tool.

principles.name: Systems-minded
principles.body: I document repeatable processes, define ownership and build small workflows that others can improve.

leadershipApproach: My approach to leadership combines accountability with curiosity: clear expectations, thoughtful feedback, evidence-based decisions and room for people to develop their own strengths.
approachIntro: Enterprise selling sits at the center. Strategy, leadership and building are the ways I connect people, decisions and practical systems. Choose a pillar to explore the evidence.
careerIntro: My path has moved from advertising and channel GTM into enterprise cybersecurity sales, team coaching, and practical systems building. The experience timeline highlights the organizations and kinds of work that shaped that path.
